description: One-click DNS setup for sending transactional email through Bytesms (in-house SMTP relay): a DKIM TXT record, a CNAME record pointing the return-path subdomain (default send, customer-chosen) to mta.bytesms.com (custom return path that carries SPF and routes bounces; the apex SPF record is left untouched) and a DMARC record.
variableDescription: dkimselector: the DKIM selector shown on the Bytesms domain page (default bytesms). dkimkey: the DKIM public key (base64 SPKI, the p= value). rpsubdomain: the return-path subdomain label shown on the Bytesms domain page (default send; a single DNS label). mtahost: the Bytesms return-path target host for the domain's sending region (e.g. mta.bytesms.com).
